data.title: Invitation to appointment at immigration office
data.summary: The Berlin immigration office (Landesamt für Einwanderung Muster) invites Nora Musterova to an in-person appointment on 15 October 2026 at 10:45 about her residence permit extension application of 1 September 2026.
data.explanation: The immigration office needs to see you in person to process your application to extend your residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis). Go to House B, waiting area 2, on 15 October 2026 at 10:45. Bring your passport, current employer certificate (Arbeitgeberbescheinigung), rental contract and a biometric photo. Your provisional certificate (Fiktionsbescheinigung) stays valid until a decision is made. If you can't attend, contact the office in advance using the details on the letter.
